deadline_kind: nominal 60 Hz budget; not measured scanout
pass_semantics: Consecutive GPU timestamp differences, matching Godot visual profiler. Non-overlapping marker intervals; elapsed time includes waits/preemption. CPU and GPU are separate lanes.
notes: Profiling and control campaigns run sequentially; their difference is descriptive, not an isolated causal overhead estimate.
Actual hardware save/restore cost and exclusive remaining compute are not observable with these interfaces.
No physical presentation feedback captured; frame budget exceedance is not a dropped-frame rate.

calibrated_trace.note: Unitrace converts kernel timestamps to its OpenCL host clock using clGetDeviceAndHostTimer. Here clGetHostTimer is verified against CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW; Vulkan GPU times are mapped with before/after calibration. Elapsed overlaps do not prove simultaneous execution.
